institution: Icahn School of Medicine at Mount Sinai

sources.label: Icahn School of Medicine at Mount Sinai: PhD in Biomedical Sciences
Mount Sinai: PhD in Biomedical Sciences admissions

summary: Mount Sinai's umbrella PhD in Biomedical Sciences, with applicants choosing among seven training areas such as microbiology, immunology and cancer biology. The admissions page lists what to submit.
detailsNote: Official information available; the published December 1 deadline has no year stated, so Fall 2027 is not confirmed. How students are admitted (rotations or a program match), funding, GRE policy and minimum English scores are not stated on the official pages we opened, so they are left out.

publishedDeadlines.label: Published application deadline (no year stated)
publishedDeadlines.note: The admissions page says 'All application materials are due by December 1, and reviews begin after this deadline.' No year is given; confirm Fall 2027 directly.

english.note: TOEFL is required if English is your second language and you are not a US resident. International applicants whose last degree was taught in English are exempt. Minimum scores are not stated.

applicationFee.note: Waivers may be granted for circumstances including financial hardship (with official documentation), military service, full-time nonprofit volunteering and underserved educational programs. The page does not limit waivers to US applicants but does not say international applicants qualify; confirm with admissions@mssm.edu.

documents: Transcripts from post-secondary institutions attended (copies accepted; official transcripts required if you enroll)
Foreign transcripts translated into English with a General Analysis evaluation from a certified credential evaluation service (international applicants)
requirements.note: Recommenders are asked for letters by email from admissions@mssm.edu; the page says the school is particularly interested in people who have seen you work in research.

international.note: The page says applications are encouraged 'regardless of country of origin'.

timeline.interviews: The page says applicants will hear about interviews during review, and decisions come within three weeks of the interview.
